titles.title: A Faithful Man
titles.plot: A man experiences unanticipated joys and heartbreaks after his wife leaves him for his best friend. When the couple reunites after the death of the best friend, the relationship is much different than it was in the past.

titles.title: All Is Well
titles.plot: A road trip, undertaken by Inder (Abhishek Bachchan) and Mr. Bhalla (Rishi Kapoor), is interrupted by their unwelcome mother.

titles.title: Almost Friends
titles.plot: Once a promising chef, now unmotivated and living at home with mom, Charlie gets by as a movie theater assistant manager. When he meets his dream girl and his estranged father returns, he struggles to figure out who he wants to be.

titles.title: Amanda and Jack Go Glamping
titles.plot: With his marriage and career against the ropes, dejected author Jack Spencer travels with his wife, Amanda, to an isolated glamping retreat in search of a spark. When a surprise double booking finds their private retreat anything but private, Jack spins into a comedic exploration of love, lost dreams, small-town wisdom, and friendship with a miniature donkey to get over himself before he loses all he holds dear.

trailer.title: Amanda and Jack Go Glamping: Trailer 1

titles.title: An Oversimplification of Her Beauty
titles.plot: After a woman fails to show up for their date, an artist (Terence Nance) ponders the divide between romantic and platonic love, and why his past relationships have failed.

titles.title: Be With Me
titles.plot: Three tales of love wrap around the true story of a blind and deaf woman named Theresa Chan. In the first an elderly shopkeeper is devoted to his sick wife. In the second, two teenage girls become soul mates and lovers. In the third a chubby security guard tries to find the courage to woo a beautiful woman who works in his building.

titles.title: Beijing Love Story
titles.plot: A pregnant woman must choose between her husband and an old flame in one of three stories dealing with love, romance and commitment.

titles.title: Blind Detective
titles.plot: A cop forced into early retirement witnesses a robbery and is teamed with a female inspector to solve the case.

titles.title: Kiss Me With All Your Love
titles.original_title: Kiss Me With All Your Love
titles.plot: Peter cares for his invalid twin sister, Berthe, and during their time together, her sexual drive awakens and she attempts to seduce him. When he eventually falls in love, he finds he is haunted by his sister's sexual fantasy.

images.caption: Kiss Me With All Your Love (2016)

titles.title: Crash Pad
titles.plot: A man thinks he has found true love with an older woman until he finds out she is married and using him to get revenge on her husband.

titles.title: The White Massai
titles.plot: A young Swiss woman makes a trip to Kenya, meets a Masai warrior and falls in love with him.

titles.title: Dil Bole Hadippa!
titles.plot: In a village where females do not play cricket, a woman (Rani Mukerji) must pose as a man in order to fulfill her dream.

titles.title: Dolly Ki Doli
titles.plot: A con woman pursues and traps young men in marriage, and on their wedding night, she takes off with all the money and jewelry.

titles.title: Hands Across the Table
titles.plot: Regi Allen (Carole Lombard) becomes a manicurist at a hotel in order to meet a rich husband, and soon she finds wealthy Allen Macklyn (Ralph Bellamy), who falls for her. Regi also goes out with Theodore Drew III (Fred MacMurray), member of a prominent family, only to find out that the Drews have lost their fortunes due to the stock market crash, and Theodore plans to marry an heiress for money himself. As feelings between Regi and Theodore develop, their careful plans start to change.

titles.title: Happy Bhag Jayegi
titles.plot: A free-spirited woman (Diana Penty) leaves her husband.

titles.title: Husband Material
titles.plot: A free-spirited woman is torn between two very different men.

titles.title: Love Switch
titles.plot: On the brink of divorce, James and Michelle have drifted apart over the years and couldn't be more different. Michelle despairs that they will never fully understand each other. On their 13th wedding anniversary, they wake up to discover they have somehow switched bodies. Unable to switch back, they are forced to understand what the other goes through on a daily basis. In the process, they develop a new sense of respect and understanding for one another.

titles.title: Meri Pyaari Bindu
titles.plot: Favorite songs, memories and an ex-girlfriend inspire a successful writer to pen an old-fashioned love story.

titles.title: Nappily Ever After
titles.plot: A soulful barber helps a woman piece her life back together after an accident at her hair salon makes her realize she is not living life to the fullest.

titles.title: Sanctuary
titles.plot: Two people with developmental disabilities long to be together in a world that keeps them apart.

titles.title: Stand Up for Love
titles.plot: Impotence puts a strain on a young couple's relationship.

titles.title: Some Kind of Beautiful
titles.plot: A woman starts to fall in love with a successful college professor who had a baby with her younger sister.

titles.title: South Solitary
titles.plot: An unmarried woman moves to a remote lighthouse with her uncle and a caretaker.

titles.title: Sultan
titles.plot: A middle-aged wrestling champion (Salman Khan) tries to make a comeback to represent India at the Olympics.

titles.title: Surviving Christmas
titles.plot: A wealthy executive, Drew Latham has no close relationships and becomes nostalgic for his childhood home as Christmas approaches. When he visits the house and finds another family living there, he offers the residents, Tom Valco and his wife, Christine, a large sum of money to pretend they are his parents. Soon Drew tests the couple's patience, and, when their daughter, Alicia, arrives, things get increasingly tense.

images.caption: Christine Valco (CATHERINE O'HARA) has a hard time explaining why she looks nothing like the understudy of the man who was hired to play her father, affectionately known as Doo-Dah (SY RICHARDSON)

Christine and Tom Valco (CATHERINE O'HARA and JAMES GANDOLFINI) rent their family out for the holidays to a single man who is willing to pay-and pay big-for an old-fashioned family Christmas.

titles.title: Tell It to the Bees
titles.plot: In 1952 Dr. Jean Markham returns to her Scottish hometown to take over her late father's medical practice. She soon becomes ostracized by the community when she begins a passionate romance with a woman who has a young son.

trailer.title: Tell It to the Bees: Trailer 1

titles.title: The Day After
titles.plot: When a woman discovers a love poem that was written for her husband, she mistakenly believes that the author is her husband's new secretary.

titles.title: The Film Critic
titles.plot: Victor, a film critic, is weary of Hollywood's romantic comedies until he meets Sofia, an attractive woman. When random events bring them together, he suspects the movie genre he hates is taking revenge.

titles.title: The Surprise
titles.plot: A rich man signs a contract to end his life. While picking out his coffin, he meets a young woman doing the same thing, and they instantly fall in love with each other. Trouble ensues when they both try to get out of their contracts.

titles.title: Three Night Stand
titles.plot: A man's plans for a romantic weekend go awry when he learns that his ex-girlfriend, whom he still secretly loves, manages the ski lodge where he and his wife are staying.

titles.title: Tonnerre
titles.plot: Maxime, a semisuccessful musician, spends time with his father in a small town. During the stay, he falls in love with a woman who is far too young for him.

titles.title: Unfinished Sky
titles.plot: An outback farmer takes in a runaway prostitute.

titles.title: Wake Up Sid
titles.plot: Sid Mehra is a young man living in Mumbai who benefits from the indulgence of his parents. After graduating from university, he makes a stab at working in his father's business, but lasts only a week. He then meets Aisha, an aspiring writer from Calcutta. Sid helps her get settled in the city and then wants to take things further -- but Aisha isn't interested because of Sid's slacker personality. Will her rejection serve as a wake-up call for Sid?

titles.title: You're Killing Me Susana
titles.plot: An actor's (Gael García Bernal) world comes crashing down after he learns that his wife (Verónica Echegui) has left him for a poet (Björn Hlynur Haraldsson) in Iowa.

titles.title: Zero
titles.plot: Short in stature but big on love, a bachelor meets two very different women who broaden his horizons and help him find purpose in life.
